### The Outpouring of God's Spirit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/outpouring-god-s-spirit
Passage: Joel 2:28-29
Points:
- Moses originally longed for all of God's people to receive the Spirit and prophesy.
- Under the old covenant, the Holy Spirit's special empowerments were given only to select leaders such as judges, priests, and kings.
- Joel foretold a coming day when God would pour out His Spirit abundantly on all believers regardless of age, gender, or social standing.
- Christ fulfilled this promise by sending the Holy Spirit at Pentecost to equip every believer for kingdom ministry.
- All Christians possess the indwelling Spirit by faith and are called to walk in obedience using their spiritual gifts.

### Bible Pathway - September 21
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-21-2013.html
Passage: Joel 2:28-31
Points:
- Joel's prophecy highlights both the internal working of the Holy Spirit and cosmic signs heralding the Day of the Lord.
- Peter proclaimed the beginning of this outpouring at Pentecost, making Joel's message central to the church.
- The gifts of the Holy Spirit are granted to strengthen the body of Christ and reveal truth to unbelievers.
- God deliberately pours out His Spirit on both men and women across all social strata for kingdom service.
- Every obedient follower of Christ is given the privilege of being used in God's overarching plan.
